item.title: Army paratroopers ordered to Middle East as U.S. weighs next move in Iran conflict
item.summary: The orders follow weeks of speculation about whether the 82nd Airborne Division would join the war, after its headquarters unit abruptly pulled out of a training exercise this month.

item.title: Trump’s move to send ICE to airports fails to break impasse or end long lines
item.summary: Airport slogs continue to put pressure on lawmakers and the White House, but a deal remains elusive as Senate Democrats hold out for restraints on immigration agents.

item.title: Tracking who Trump is appointing to fill key administration roles
item.summary: Follow President Trump’s progress filling over 800 positions, among about 1,300 that require Senate confirmation, in this tracker from The Washington Post and the Partnership for Public Service.

item.title: Senate Republicans pitch deal to end DHS shutdown, but Trump isn’t sold
item.summary: The deal under discussion would fund the department except for the part of Immigration and Customs Enforcement charged with arresting and deporting undocumented immigrants.

item.title: Oklahoma energy executive Alan Armstrong sworn in as U.S. senator
item.summary: Oklahoma Gov. Kevin Stitt (R) appointed Armstrong to the Senate seat vacated by Sen. Markwayne Mullin (R), who was confirmed as homeland security secretary Monday.

item.title: Inside the GOP struggle with bigotry among young activists
item.summary: Many Republicans dismiss such party members even as white supremacists like Nick Fuentes gain popularity, but there’s growing unease at their presence in the rank and file.

item.title: House Democrat accused of misspending covid-19 money could be expelled
item.summary: The family health care company Rep. Sheila Cherfilus-McCormick worked for was sent FEMA money it shouldn’t have received. She’s accused of using the money on a run for office.

item.title: DOJ agrees to pay ex-Trump adviser Michael Flynn to settle malicious prosecution suit
item.summary: The amount of the settlement was not disclosed in court papers.

item.title: What a GOP loss in Trump’s Mar-a-Lago district says about the midterms
item.summary: Including off-year elections last year, Democrats have flipped 30 Republican seats since the start of 2025.

item.title: Supreme Court finds internet service providers not liable for users’ pirated music
item.summary: The unanimous decision means Cox Communications will probably not have to pay a huge judgment in a case brought by dozens of music companies, including Sony.
